mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the venous valves was most worthwhile: the contracting muscle and valve picture connected the parts to forward blood flow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the thin-walled veins was predictable, and its result added little explanation of their function.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the vessel components and their purposes were reasonably clear.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the vessel network connects to the heart and other systems, though the last two choices were essentially assembly steps.
